# FuzzyRoutines

<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Timur Gilmullin and Fuzzy Technologies
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

> Scalar fuzzy computing in Python. This source describes 2.1.0 on CPython 3.13 and 3.14. Install exactly `fuzzyroutines==2.1.0` when it is available on PyPI; otherwise use the reviewed matching CI wheel in the agent guide. The published 2.0.0 baseline remains available for reproducing earlier results. Installation instructions do not establish publication. Verify installed version and source revision before execution. The default scalar core has no external runtime dependencies.

## Start and verify

- [Agent entrypoint and versioned capability map](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/agent-quickstart/): exact 2.1.0 installation, memberships, plots and JSON evidence; reviewed-wheel fallback before PyPI availability.
- [Русский](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/ru/agent-quickstart/): запрос помощнику, версии API и объяснение результатов.
- [简体中文](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/zh-CN/agent-quickstart/): 智能体请求、API 版本与结果解释。
- [API reference](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/api/): supported imports and contracts; `/latest/` is moving documentation, not an installed-version guarantee.
- [Migration from 1.0.3](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/migration/1.0.3-to-2.0.0/): compatibility and corrected numerical behavior.

## 2.1 capability map

- [Historical Universal Fuzzy Scale](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/universal-fuzzy-scale/): `CreateUniversalFuzzyScale`, `UniversalFuzzyScalePolicy` and `UniversalFuzzyScaleDomains` preserve original coefficients, exact-last selection and centroid windows. Existing reconstruction through 2.0 primitives remains valid.
- [Linguistic encoding](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/linguistic-encoding/): `LinguisticCodec` explicitly maps labels, representatives and ordered grades. Grades are not probabilities; centroids are representative coordinates, not learned network weights. A representative average is not the centroid of an aggregated fuzzy set.
- [Explainable inference](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/inference/): `fuzzyroutines.inference.MamdaniModel` aggregates fuzzy output sets and can compute their centroid; zero/first-order `SugenoModel` averages rule consequences. Policies, domains, no-fire failures and rule traces are explicit.
- [Optional NumPy batches](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/numpy-batches/): `fuzzyroutines.batches.EvaluateMembershipBatch` and `FuzzifyBatch`, with optional `numpy` extra and explicit `backend="numpy"`. No automatic switch; custom or composed membership callables remain scalar.
- [CPU neural integration example](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/neural-integration/): repository PyTorch script with fixed fuzzy encodings, raw/centroid/full-grade ablations and a separate membership-output head. Optional dependencies; no Torch dependency in the core and no guaranteed accuracy improvement.
- [Differentiable Sugeno research](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/differentiable-sugeno/): bounded repository prototype, zero/first-order consequences, trainable smooth memberships, scalar parity and gradient checks. Decision: no public tensor backend in 2.1. Preserve its recorded experimental limits and use matching source files.
- Project homepage: [English](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/), [Русский](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/ru/), [简体中文](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/zh-CN/).

Repository neural/research programs are separate from the installed package. Membership grades do not need to sum to one; define normalization, domains and no-match handling for the application. Without a Python execution environment, explain the commands and expected values without claiming execution. Preserve artifact hashes, versions, inputs and numerical evidence when reporting a run.
